title: Dead Eye OP Script  Project x Hub
features:
Aim Assist – Gently guide the target to the nearest visible enemy within the FOV.

Wall Check – Ignores hidden enemies behind walls to avoid suspicious sights.

TriggerBot – Automatically fire the weapon when the aim crosses a valid target.

Circle FOV – Visually renders the scope of the target assistance.

Aim Key Select – Set the key that must be held to activate the aim.

Aim Part – Toggle the point of focus of the aim between the head and the enemy's trunk.

FOV Size – Adjusts the size of the circular target detection area on the screen.

Smoothness – It controls the smoothness of the target movement to appear more human and legitimate.

Trigger Delay – Adds a delay to automatic firing to simulate human reaction time.

ESP Players – Highlights enemy players with a bright outline visible through walls.

Speed Changer – Enables modification of the character's walking speed.

Speed Amount – Defines the exact amount of motion speed on the ground.

Jump Power – Activates the character's jump force modification.

Jump Amount – Sets the maximum height that the character can jump.

Noclip – Removes the collision of the character to cross walls and solid objects.

Fly – It allows you to fly freely across the map in any direction, ignoring gravity.

Fly Speed – Adjust the displacement speed while the flight mode is active.
